items.title: Derek Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 5, 2021
items.q: The transcript only shows the interviewer introducing himself as Monk Rowe and the interviewee thanking him. No personal or professional relationship is described.

ctx.x: Derek was interviewed via Zoom on March 5, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to have, on a Friday afternoon, Derek Brown with me. And we are not together but we’re going to be together for about an hour. Thanks for joining me.
Yeah, thanks for having me, Monk. I’m glad to be here.
